themes.name: Corporate
themes.description: Professional light design with slate/sky blue accents and Roboto typography.

themes.name: Creative (Vibrant)
themes.description: Colorful pink/rose background with deep violet accents and Outfit typography.

themes.name: Elegant (Serif)

themes.name: Playful
themes.description: Fun, warm yellow design with orange accents and Quicksand typography.

themes.name: Nature (Earthy)
themes.description: Calming earthy green and cream design with Lora headings and Inter body.

themes.name: Cyberpunk (Neon Midnight)
themes.description: Dark neon cyberpunk theme with cyan, pink accents and Outfit/Roboto typography.

themes.name: Sunset (Warm)
themes.description: Warm orange/clay peach design with Outfit/Inter typography.

themes.name: Ocean
themes.description: Fresh sea breeze blue design with Outfit/Inter typography.

themes.name: Minimalist
themes.description: Stark monochrome black & white design with Playfair Display/Inter typography.

themes.name: Lavender
themes.description: Modern lavender geometric design with Poppins typography.

title.name: Title Layouts
title.description: Layouts designed for opening slides, section breaks, and presentations headers.

types.name: Main Title
types.description: Centered title slide layout with metadata fields and a separator line.

types.name: Split Title
types.description: Split column/row layout designed for title slides.

types.name: Section Divider
types.description: Layout designed for introducing a new presentation section.

bullets.name: Bullet Points
bullets.description: Standard lists or grids containing multiple sequential headers and descriptions.

types.name: Standard List
types.description: A classic vertical list of items, splitting into a 2-column layout when there are more than 4 items.

types.name: Big Bullets
types.description: Bold text bullets with larger typography for emphasizing key points.

types.name: Bullets Grid
types.description: A structured grid of bullet items with headers and descriptions.

types.name: Vertical Bullets Timeline
types.description: A layout displaying bullet items connected along a vertical timeline line.

cards.name: Card Layouts
cards.description: Grid or block cards to visually separate and present group data.

types.name: Simple Cards
types.description: Clean border-based card grid for showcasing features or items.

types.name: Left Accent Cards
types.description: Cards with colored left-border accent indicators.

types.name: Numbered Cards
types.description: Cards displaying an auto-incrementing index number on the left.

types.name: Filled Cards
types.description: Cards styled with a light alternative theme background.

stats.name: Key Metrics & Statistics
stats.description: Large text indicators highlighting critical figures or metrics.

types.name: Stats Grid
types.description: Grid display of big numbers and their descriptions. Automatically switches layout configurations depending on item count.

types.name: Stats Row
types.description: A single row/column layout displaying statistics side-by-side or stacked.

types.name: Large Stat Callout
types.description: Emphasizes a single massive key metric with a detailed text callout description.

timelines.name: Timelines
timelines.description: Display events, steps, or progression sequences chronologically.

types.name: Horizontal Timeline
types.description: Steps placed horizontally on a timeline track line, scaling from 2 to 6 items.

types.name: Vertical Timeline
types.description: Steps oriented along a vertical track line with dots.

types.name: Alternating Timeline
types.description: Steps arranged in an alternating left-to-right zigzag fashion along a central axis.
